name: 41868-visionprompt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (`--gres=gpu:1`).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, single-process `uni` executor, one in-process engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 36 req/s, 120 warmup requests by count, bounded at 1320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap; all 1320 fall inside the scored window.
workload: single-turn image+text chat: 512 synthetic text tokens plus one 512x512 JPEG in, 60 tokens out, all lengths fixed. guidellm `synthetic_text` + `synthetic_image`, row-index seeded so the pixels differ per request; driven in-process through the `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A single-GPU vision chat assistant answering one image plus short text per request at 36 requests per second.
launch:
# enable-prefix-caching is off deliberately: every request carries byte-different image
# pixels and independently sampled text, so there is nothing real to reuse.
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
quantization: fp8
max-model-len: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
distributed-executor-backend: uni
max-num-seqs: 64
block-size: 16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
